name: reviewer-is-distributed-not-generated
body:
`implementation-phase-reviewer` must be a generic distributed opencode-suite hidden subagent — installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/` — not a repo-local agent the agent-builder generates into a project's `.opencode/agents/`. The reviewer never runs gates and holds no repo-specific build grants (its work is repo-agnostic structural review), so generating it per repo is duplication. The distributed agent set grows six to seven.

Required changes:

1. NEW `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` — the generic template, de-repo'd from the repo's own consumer artifact `.opencode/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` (read it for the grant shape and body; that file is a consumer artifact and is NEVER edited). Frontmatter: a generic `description:` (no "for the apg repository"), `mode: subagent`, `hidden: true`, and NO `generated: true` marker. Grants: the read-only apg suite (`apg_query`, `apg_find_symbol`, `apg_modules`, `apg_module_files`, `apg_module_structs`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_file_path`, `apg_methods`, `apg_struct`, `apg_callers`, `apg_callees`, `apg_uses`, `apg_unresolved`, `apg_hunk`), the plan read tools (`apg_plan`, `apg_plan_phases`, `apg_plan_tasks`), and `apg_review` / `apg_review_add` / `apg_review_resolve` / `apg_review_reject` + `apg_plan_complete`. NO `question`, no edit grant, no scan, no `apg_plan_done`/`apg_plan_undone`/`apg_plan_note`, no spec/plan authoring (`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`), no `apg_plan_render`. It carries the common distributed-reviewer shape: the positive read-guard rule ("graph state is reached only through the apg tools" / node and transient files "never read directly"), stop-and-report tool-failure prose, and the closed writer↔reviewer cycle prose (it never actions feedback).

2. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` no longer offers or generates the reviewer: remove it from the `description:` (line 2), the roster intro (line 60), the entire `### implementation-phase-reviewer (always)` section (lines 234-272), and workflow step 4 (line 382). Statements elsewhere in the template that speak of scaffolding the reviewer — the step-7 verify checks (lines 405-407) and the common-shape note that "the implementation-phase-reviewer additionally obeys the no-grant / no-leak rule" (lines 391-392) — are removed or reworded, since the agent-builder no longer scaffolds it.

3. `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`: reword the `### Codebase agents` section (lines 434-441) and the task-allowlist paragraph (lines 462-466) so `implementation-phase-reviewer` is part of the DISTRIBUTED set `apg init` installs, not "generated by the agent-builder into `.opencode/agents/`". Its `task` allowlist entry (line 15) stays valid — it is the task target.

4. `src/install.rs` (`rust.apg.install`): add `("implementation-phase-reviewer.md", include_str!("../opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md"))` to the `AGENTS` table (lines 255-277) and `"implementation-phase-reviewer.md"` to `KNOWN_AGENT_FILES` (lines 282-289); update the "six distributed agents" doc comments to seven (lines 252-254, 279-281, 417).

5. `src/lib.rs` (`rust.apg.main`): the "six distributed agents (`AGENTS`)" doc comment (line 161) becomes seven.

6. `AGENTS.md`: lines 222 and 767 "six distributed agents" becomes seven plus the reviewer name; lines 141 and 796-799 must stop saying `implementation-phase-reviewer` is generated by the agent-builder (only `*-implementer` agents are generated).

7. `README.md`: line 194 "six distributed agents" becomes seven plus the reviewer name.

8. `tests/main_e2e.rs` (e2e tier): extend `installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard` (its 5-prompt list) and `acceptance_node_edge_surface_is_transparent_and_pinned_in_help_tools_and_agents` (its pinned list) to include `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`. The user approved extending these coherence tests.

Acceptance criteria:
- `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` exists, is `mode: subagent` + `hidden: true` + NO `generated: true`, is generic (no repo-specific prose), states the positive read-guard rule and stop-and-report, and carries exactly the grant set above (no `question`, no edit, no scan, no done/undone/note, no authoring, no `apg_plan_render`).
- `apg init` embeds and installs it into `~/.opencode/agents/`; every "six distributed agents" statement becomes seven (the install doc comments, `src/lib.rs`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`).
- The agent-builder template no longer lists or generates it; the navigator template describes it as distributed; the navigator's `task` allowlist entry is unchanged.
- The two named coherence tests include it; `.opencode/agents/**` are NOT edited.
- The `implemented-by` edge from the owning component to the new file is DEFERRED: the file does not resolve in the branch graph until the plan declares it as a planned File node and the implementer creates it (see `solution.note.distributed-reviewer-deferred-edge`).
